title: Fix auth parsing for proxies
label: risky
justification: Fixes CVE-2023-32681 (proxy URL parsing silently dropped embedded basic-auth credentials). prepend_scheme_if_needed carries this incident tag in the curated set.
retrieval_caveat: KNOWN RETRIEVAL LIMITATION (see PROBLEMS.md, Phase 6): this PR predates psf/requests' migration to a src/ layout, so GitHub's API returns this PR's file path without the src/ prefix (e.g. requests/utils.py), while the current index only has src/-prefixed paths. The diff parser correctly identifies the changed function by name (verified directly against the live diff) -- the exact-string file_path match in the DB lookup is what silently misses, so retrieval reports already_indexed=false / no incident tag for a function that IS actually indexed and tagged under its current path. Not a production-realistic failure (a live incoming PR always uses the current layout, matching the index) -- included in the eval anyway because these are the real, well-known historical incident PRs, and this is an honest, real limitation of the exact-path-match lookup key worth surfacing regardless.

title: Prevent Response self-reference in redirect history
label: risky
justification: resolve_redirects is NOT in the curated incident set -- deliberately included to test whether the system over- or under-flags based on the incident tag alone. Ground truth 'risky' here is my own judgment call, not a system output: redirect handling in this same file (sessions.py) has caused two real CVEs (rebuild_auth/should_strip_auth, CVE-2018-18074), so a change to resolve_redirects itself touches structurally fragile territory per SPEC section 8's 'touched something fragile' clause, independent of whether this specific diff is a good fix. This is the honest edge case: retrieval's real callers/no-incident-tag result should be correct (it won't find a tag), so the real test is whether the LLM's own judgment (not just tag-matching) still flags elevated risk for redirect-handling code.

title: Allow for overriding of specific pool key params
